verdict.rationale: Algolia documents InstantSearch.js as an open source UI library [algolia-docs-8], so some of its frontend tooling can be read under an open license. A community user, however, cites Algolia's closed-source license as a reason for moving to Elasticsearch [algolia-comm-10], which indicates the core hosted search engine is not open. Missing for 10: open-source core search engine/backend, named license terms, evidence that API clients and the CLI are openly licensed.
